# Unit Economics

`unit-economics` · v1.1.0 · Diagnose · Analytics & Experimentation
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/unit-economics/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** Can we afford to spend more on acquisition, and what CAC can we not exceed?

**Inputs:** Business model, revenue per customer (ARPA/ACV/AOV), gross margin, retention or churn, and CAC (or ad spend + customers)

**Output:** LTV, CAC, LTV:CAC, CAC payback, and a verdict against the 3:1 and payback reference points, with sources

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill unit-economics`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/unit-economics/resources/unit-economics.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/unit-economics/resources/unit-economics.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: not recorded yet.

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- Uses gross-margin LTV, so it reads lower than a revenue LTV; compare it only with other gross-margin figures.
- LTV is only as good as the churn estimate, and early-stage churn estimates tend to be optimistic. Run a range, not one number.
- Blended CAC (all new customers over all sales and marketing spend) flatters paid channels. Use paid CAC for channel decisions and say which one you used.
- A healthy LTV:CAC with a long payback can still strain a cash-tight business; the ratio is not a cash plan.

**Review before acting:** The founder or finance lead confirms the churn and CAC inputs, and which CAC was used, before the result sets a budget or a CAC ceiling. Run the optimistic and the conservative churn case.
